title: Grader structural feature row (grader-features)
description: Appended by scripts/grading.py extract (run by the change-grader agent) after the reviewer roster approves. Carries the deterministic structural feature row for the change — the map that tells the grader where to read, never a verdict. The grader runs before the commit, so by default the extractor diffs the base against a snapshot of the live working tree (staged, unstaged, and untracked changes) rather than a commit; --head names a committed ref for post-hoc grading. The script contains no decision logic; the grader decides by reading the diff. Missing inputs emit null, never a false zero: an unresolved base ref or a failed snapshot nulls the diff fields, an absent/unreadable handoff log nulls build/review/retry facts, and the grader reads null as concern. This record is ephemeral per-feature working state; there is no calibration log in this version (see the change-grading skill).

features.description: The structural feature row. Diff-derived fields are null when the base ref does not resolve; handoff-derived fields are null when the handoff log is absent or unreadable.

head_ref.description: The diff's right-hand side: a commit SHA in --head mode, or the content-addressed tree SHA of the working-tree snapshot by default. Null when the snapshot failed.

head_kind.description: How head_ref was obtained: 'worktree' for the default uncommitted-snapshot diff (the grader runs before the commit), or 'commit' when --head named a committed ref for post-hoc grading.

review_roster.description: The reviewers the active review-plan dispatched for this change — the risk-proportional roster, a subset of the floor plus extras. Null when no plan was recorded (the full-battery default). The reviewer_hedging facet judges silence against this: a floor reviewer absent because the plan scoped it out is expected, not a hedge.
